translation_notes: the flagged site (lines 118-126) has no `datatype=` at all: the four Literal(x, lang="en") calls per iteration are LANGUAGE literals, so this region exercises the language half of the stratum (same as its sibling build_core_v6_0_0.py__<module>_142).

`Literal(lab, lang="en")` -> `{lab}@en` (glued suffix on an interpolation, inside `+{ }`), likewise `{dfn}@en` and `{S("R1")}@en`; lab, dfn and S(...) are plain str, so rdflib builds exactly the same Literal (the driver kills the mutants that drop or change the tag on any of the three).

the four `g2.add` calls on the same subject are folded into one `+{ {p} a owl:AnnotationProperty ; rdfs:label ... }` with `@graph g2`; `p = SEM[ap]` becomes `p = sem:{ap}` (a prefixed name with a computed local part; same IRI, checked by a mutant that lowercases the local name). SEM = Namespace(...) is therefore dropped from translated.ldpy (the draft kept `SEM[ap]` without defining SEM).
prefixes declared: sem, rdfs, owl, skos, dcterms (the five that appear as prefixed names); rdf/xsd/prov never appear (RDF.type is `a`).

context shim (context_shim.py): the region reads `BASEDIR` and `S`, not defined in the extracted lines. BASEDIR (a hardcoded /home/claude path in the source) is restored to the shim directory; S is copied verbatim with only the key it looks up, R1 (taxonomy_v1_0_0.py C["R1"], same commit). original.py and translated.ldpy import both from the shim instead of the BASEDIR assignment.
fixture 02-ontology/semtech_tbox_v5_2_0.ttl: stand-in for the real tbox, with a class, an unrelated property and sem:criticalTip carrying a French label, so the added triples meet existing data.
anti-hollow-green: `@fr` instead of `@en` on definition, dropped tag on the source or on the label, and a lowercased local name each made rdfeval check FAIL; restored, green.
optimization_notes: optimized.py: the four `g2.add((p, …))` become one `g2 += [ … ]` of four triples, as in the sibling region build_core_v6_0_0 <module>_142.
optimized.ldpy: identical to translated.ldpy. Its `+{ {p} a owl:AnnotationProperty ; rdfs:label {lab}@en ; … }` under the header's `@graph g2` is already the island form of `g2 += [...]`.
Not compressed: `p = SEM[ap]` / `p = sem:{ap}` stays, because the driver compares the loop's last module-level p. No exception to the symmetry rule.
header_optimization_notes: Python: URIRef, XSD and PROV go.
LD Python: Namespace, URIRef, Literal and the whole rdflib.namespace import go (the region writes sem:/owl:/rdfs:/skos:/dcterms: names). The five @prefix lines are used.
